summary: No. The 35 pytest cases drive the transferred catalogctl binary against native WAL/heap/index/replica/health artifacts and they fail the starter for real contract reasons (25 fail / 10 pass, Harbor NOP 0.0; oracle 1.0). Three named instruction pillars remain unenforced: checkpoint redo of committed WAL after checkpoint.lsn, decode that must not apply or advance the slot, and CDC-from-WAL versus a heap scan that reuses version.LSN and skips uncommitted rows. Those shortcuts can score 1. Constraint fail-closed, epoch fence, inspect/empty-check isolation, unique/FK/frozen/hold rejects, and warehouse preservation are otherwise semantic and deterministic.

evidence.observation: Solver-visible work request names the Go catalog plane, binding contract, catalogctl CLI, snapshot isolation, commit-after-WAL, CDC-from-WAL, LSN/epoch-fenced FK-safe apply, checkpoint redo of committed records, fail-closed rejects, index rebuild after COMMIT and recover, inspect/empty-check isolation, health rewrites, and warehouse hands-off.

Binding contract specifies visibility, WAL commit order, constraint codes, index key format, decode from replica_slot.confirmed_lsn+1 without heap invention or slot advance, epoch-mismatched apply of nothing, FK-rank apply, checkpoint identity, recover redo of committed WAL with lsn > checkpoint.lsn, CLI exit 2, and health/cdc/apply-report/rejects schemas.

35 independent pytest functions with docstrings. Each case copies data/sql/config into tmp_path, sets CATALOG_ROOT, runs /app/catalog/bin/catalogctl, and parses sqlite/JSON/JSONL. Hidden /tests/fixtures cover insert, unique, FK, frozen, hold-qty, and reversed parent-child. No source greps of catalog arithmetic.
Canonical reward runner: creates /logs/verifier at runtime, writes 0 then 1/0 after pytest, installs nothing, collects test_outputs.py.

Starter appends WAL BEGIN before argv parse and --reset-output truncates WAL, so unknown-flag, missing --input, unknown-command, and reset-output tests fail the inherited binary for contract mutations rather than missing files.

Seed checkpoints at durable committed LSN, then appends only the uncommitted s-crash-pending WAL/heap row. Replica confirmed_lsn is skuEnd (2520). No committed WAL exists after checkpoint.lsn, so recover-that-only-restores-checkpoint matches recover_skips_uncommitted.

Starter decode is a heap scan of sku rows using row numbers as LSN. test_f2p_decode_uses_wal_lsn only requires sorted lsns with lines[0].lsn > confirmed_lsn, which a committed-heap filter on version.LSN also satisfies.

Replica opens with PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON against replica_schema.sql, so test_f2p_apply_fk_order (offer-then-sku file order, both rows must exist) does require parent-before-child apply, not mere end-state coincidence.
Oracle copies repaired Go modules, rebuilds catalogctl, and drives recover/decode/inspect on the public CLI. It does not write reward files or branch on verifier identity.
Harbor oracle reward 1.0; pytest collected 35 items, 35 passed in 329.93s. No oracle special-casing in tests.

Harbor NOP reward 0.0; 25 failed, 10 passed. The 10 NOP passes are P2P presence/schema/happy-path (ctl, go.mod, warehouse SHA-256, health keys, accepted sku insert, checkpoint lsn, apply-report ints). F2P failures are usage mutation, inspect recover, constraint rejects, recover/decode/apply/index semantics.
artifacts = ["/app/catalog"]; environment_mode = "separate". Hidden /tests/fixtures are unavailable to the agent. verifier timeout_sec = 1800 covers the ~330s oracle pytest runtime.

findings.why_it_matters: Instruction and contract require recover to restore the checkpoint then redo committed WAL records with lsn > checkpoint.lsn. Seed writes checkpoint at the durable committed max and only then appends uncommitted s-crash-pending, so no committed post-checkpoint WAL exists. Tests only assert that pk is gone, epoch is unchanged, and indexes omit the crash pk. A recover that restores checkpoint and drops uncommitted rows, without replaying later committed WAL, scores 1. There is no commit-then-recover (without a new checkpoint) case that requires redo.
findings.minimal_remediation: After a successful commit of a hidden fixture row, run recover without writing a new checkpoint and require that committed pk to remain on the heap and in sku_code. Keep the existing crash-pending skip.
findings.regression_risk: Do not require recover to bump epoch or to install s-crash-pending. Checkpoint itself must still leave replica epoch unchanged.

findings.why_it_matters: Contract: decode does not apply to the replica and does not advance the slot. No test fingerprints replica.sqlite or replica_slot.json across decode. test_f2p_apply_is_monotonic only asserts the second apply has applied==0 and skipped>=1; the first apply is unchecked, so a decode that already applied the batch still passes. inspect/empty-check isolation is tested; decode isolation is not. A fused decode+apply implementation can full-score.
findings.minimal_remediation: Fingerprint slot.confirmed_lsn, slot.epoch, and replica bytes before/after decode and require them unchanged. On the first apply after a fresh decode of unapplied WAL, require applied>=1 (or confirmed_lsn advance) before the idempotent second apply.
findings.regression_risk: Keep stale-epoch apply --cdc rejecting the whole batch without advancing confirmed_lsn. Decode must still rewrite cdc.jsonl and health.json.

findings.why_it_matters: Contract forbids scanning the heap to invent CDC. test_f2p_decode_uses_wal_lsn only checks sorted lsns and lines[0].lsn > confirmed_lsn, which is exactly the starter's row-number failure mode (NOP assert 1 > 2520). Heap versions already store the WAL mutation lsn. Filtering committed heap rows with version.LSN > confirmed_lsn, filling before from xmax'd versions, and skipping s-crash-pending passes decode_skips_uncommitted, decode_uses_wal_lsn, and decode_update_has_before without walking wal.jsonl. CDC-from-WAL is not distinguished from a smarter heap dump.
findings.minimal_remediation: Verifier-only: append a committed WAL INSERT (or COMMIT a mutation) without installing the heap row, then require that pk/lsn to appear in cdc.jsonl; or require each CDC lsn to match a committed WAL mutation record rather than a heap version.lsn scan. Do not leak that fixture into the agent image.
findings.regression_risk: Keep skipping txns without COMMIT and keep crash pending / CRASH out of cdc.jsonl. Do not require CDC to include BEGIN/COMMIT records.

findings.why_it_matters: Fail-closed path is tested for UNIQUE_CONFLICT, FK_MISSING, FROZEN_TENANT (offer insert), and HOLD_QTY, plus no heap install on unique abort. Contract also names PK_CONFLICT, CHECK_FAIL (unknown table, missing pk, non-integer qty), offer_code uniqueness, FROZEN hold insert/update, frozen-tenant sku/tenant maintenance still allowed, DELETE apply, and apply within-rank by lsn. Those same-class cases are untested. They do not by themselves let a heap-CDC or no-redo recover pass, but they leave stated codes unenforced.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional holdouts: duplicate pk insert, unknown table or qty=-1 CHECK_FAIL, duplicate offer_code, frozen hold, sku insert on a frozen tenant accepted, and one CDC delete applied to replica.
findings.regression_risk: Keep business rejects at exit 0. Do not reject sku/tenant maintenance on FROZEN tenants.

findings.why_it_matters: recovery_ok, visibility_ok, and index_ok are asserted true only after recover, when a constant-true writer succeeds. test_f2p_health_rewrite_after_decode_apply passed NOP because it only checks that health.json exists with cdc_source=wal and integer durable_lsn/epoch. Pending-sentinel inspect/empty-check cases do not require those booleans false. Native heap/index assertions already carry the recover outcome; the iff health flags are not independently falsified.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: with the pending sentinel installed, assert visibility_ok or recovery_ok is false on inspect; after recover, assert true. Or drop the always-true post-recover flag tests as redundant with heap/index checks.
findings.regression_risk: None if left as-is; inspect must still not recover the sentinel.

findings.why_it_matters: Unknown flag/command and --reset-output tests compare only WAL bytes. Contract also forbids heap, index, replica, slot, checkpoint, and warehouse mutation on those paths. Starter's actual usage bug is WAL BEGIN / WAL truncate, so NOP still fails, but a usage path that truncates indexes or the slot while leaving WAL intact would pass.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: reuse fingerprint_state (wal/slot/indexes/replica) on unknown-flag, unknown-command, and --reset-output cases.
findings.regression_risk: Keep --reset-output allowed to wipe /app/catalog/out. empty-check with --reset-output must still exit 0.

change_scope: tenant-catalog-logical-cdc-plane/tests/fixtures/ (verifier-only holdouts for WAL-only CDC and commit-then-recover redo)
do_not_change: instruction.md work request and absolute artifact paths
Hidden constraint fixtures (dup_sku, fk_hold, frozen_offer, hold_qty, parent_child, insert_sku)
next_gate: Repair verifier coverage for checkpoint redo, decode isolation, and WAL-versus-heap CDC; re-freeze; re-run Verifier Engineer before remaining Pre-LLMaJ specialists/aggregate.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.REQUIREMENT: Repair the existing Go catalog plane; drive work through /app/catalog/bin/catalogctl; do not move catalog logic to another language or throw away the WAL protocol.
Unknown flags or an unknown command exit 2 before WAL, heap, index, replica, or slot mutation.
commit requires --input; missing --input exits 2 without opening a transaction.
--reset-output may delete files under /app/catalog/out only; it must not truncate WAL, heap, indexes, checkpoint, replica, slot, or warehouse.
Snapshot isolation: a snapshot is the txn_id at BEGIN; evaluate constraints against the writer snapshot plus its write set; uncommitted versions from other transactions are invisible.
A transaction is committed only when its COMMIT record is in wal.jsonl; heap and index installation happen after that append, never before.

Constraint failures fail closed: append a reject {txn_id, code, table, pk, detail}, WAL ABORT, no heap/index install. Codes: PK_CONFLICT, UNIQUE_CONFLICT, FK_MISSING, CHECK_FAIL, FROZEN_TENANT, HOLD_QTY. Business rejects exit 0.
Writer snapshot plus write set allows parent sku then child offer in one commit regardless of JSONL file order.

indexes.json sku_code and offer_code map tenant_id\0code to visible pk; rebuild from committed-visible rows after every successful COMMIT and after recover; aborted/invisible versions must not remain.

decode walks WAL from confirmed_lsn+1, emits one CDC object per committed mutation in WAL lsn order with before/after images, skips txns with no COMMIT, does not scan the heap to invent records, replaces cdc.jsonl, and does not apply or advance the slot.
apply: epoch != replica_slot.epoch rejects the whole batch (apply nothing, do not advance confirmed_lsn); lsn <= confirmed_lsn is skipped; confirmed_lsn is monotonic.

Records that share a txn_id apply in FK rank (tenant, sku, offer, hold) and within a rank by lsn; INSERT/UPDATE upsert; DELETE removes; apply-report fields applied/skipped/rejected/confirmed_lsn/epoch are integers.
checkpoint writes checkpoint.json with lsn equal to durable WAL max, plus txn_id, epoch, and visible committed heap identity (not uncommitted); it does not change replica epoch.

recover restores heap and indexes from checkpoint, then redos WAL records with lsn > checkpoint.lsn that belong to committed transactions; uncommitted WAL is not installed; recover does not bump replica_slot.epoch; after redo, rebuild indexes from visible committed rows.
inspect and empty-check rewrite health.json from observed state and must not recover, decode-apply, bump epoch, or append WAL. empty-check does not assign a txn_id.

Every successful commit, recover, decode, apply, checkpoint, inspect, and empty-check rewrites health.json with the contracted fields; cdc_source is the string wal; epoch and replica_epoch equal the slot epoch.
Leave /app/catalog/warehouse untouched; do not use warehouse as commit snapshot, CDC source, or replica apply source.
Binding contract at /app/catalog/docs/catalog-contract.md; knobs in /app/catalog/config/catalog.json; apply may take --cdc <path>.
Usage errors exit 2; successful operator commands and business rejects exit 0.
A FROZEN tenant rejects INSERT or UPDATE of offer or hold; tenant and sku maintenance on a frozen tenant is still allowed.

PHANTOM_TESTS: None material. test_p2p_go_module (non-shebang catalogctl plus go.mod module catalog) and test_p2p_ctl_exists / test_p2p_contract_exists enforce stated artifact properties. test_f2p_indexes_match_after_commit key t00\0NEW00 is the contract index encoding, not an unstated helper name. Pending-sentinel inspect/empty-check checks prevent recover side effects the contract forbids.
WEAK_OR_VACUOUS_ASSERTIONS: VE-01: recover tests never require redo of a committed WAL record after checkpoint.lsn.
VE-02: decode is not shown to leave replica/slot unchanged; first apply in the monotonic test need not apply anything.
VE-03: decode_uses_wal_lsn does not bind CDC lsn/pk to wal.jsonl; a committed-heap filter on version.LSN passes.
VE-05: health booleans asserted true only after recover; health_rewrite_after_decode_apply passed NOP.
VE-06: usage tests compare WAL bytes only.
test_f2p_indexes_rebuild_after_recover: seed indexes already omit s-crash-pending (indexes written before crashPending), so leaving indexes untouched also passes.
role_output.IMPLEMENTATION_COUPLING: Low and mostly legitimate. Tests invoke catalogctl and parse native sqlite/JSON/JSONL. go.mod / non-shebang checks enforce the stated Go plane rather than helper names or file split. Index key t00\0NEW00 is the public index format. CATALOG_ROOT relocation is harness isolation, not a solver-visible knob; a binary that honors only /app/catalog still fails tmp-home commit/inspect cases. No control-flow greps.
role_output.FLAKINESS_RISK: LOW. No sleeps, unseeded RNG, or host-load thresholds. Per-test tmp_path copies isolate WAL/heap/replica. generated_at uses wall clock but is only checked for key presence. Oracle pytest took 330s copying the seeded catalog; verifier timeout 1800s. Shared /app/catalog is the copy source; a binary that ignores CATALOG_ROOT can pollute later copies, but a correct CATALOG_ROOT implementation is order-independent.
role_output.ANTI_CHEAT_RISK: MEDIUM. Separate verifier, hidden fixtures, warehouse SHA-256, pending sentinel, stale-epoch --cdc, and SQLite FK-on replica apply prevent hardcoding the quiet sample or skipping constraint/epoch/inspect work. Residual full-score shortcuts: heap CDC filtered by version.LSN > confirmed_lsn, recover that only restores checkpoint, and fused decode+apply. Those game named WAL/redo/decode-apply requirements without failing current asserts.
role_output.ORACLE_NOP_ASSESSMENT: Oracle solve.sh installs repaired Go modules, rebuilds catalogctl, and runs the public recover/decode/inspect path; tests do not branch on oracle identity, usernames, or solution hashes. Harbor jobs/2026-08-17__22-21-42 reward 1.0 with 35/35 pass. NOP jobs/2026-08-17__22-28-58 reward 0.0 with 25 fail / 10 pass: starter WAL-before-parse, inspect recover, replica-lag constraints, heap-number CDC, reverse-FK apply, and recover that installs uncommitted WAL and bumps epoch fail for substantive contract reasons. The 10 NOP passes are expected P2P presence/schema/happy-path, not vacuous F2P.
